newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen building on gains.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen building on gains.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to extend their week-long climb at the opening Friday, dealers said.

"I think the market will close the week on a firm note, because there are many positive signs including the fact a U.S. interest rate hike now seems rather unlikely," said Miguel Daneri at traders Boston Securities. "Those who sold Latin American stocks up until a few weeks ago fearing that credit would be tightened are now buying back."
The blue-chip MerVal index .MERV has gained 2.6 percent so far this week to 742.51, nearly an eight-week high.
Traders noted the U.S. markets were restrained by options expirations in early trading, but Argentine ADRs remained selectively firm.
